summary: Let Z be the sum over s of Y ∩ ker(sΦ₀ − Φ₁); Φ₁ maps Z into Φ₀(Z)'s preimage, so Φ₁ = ψ∘Φ₀ on Z for an endomorphism ψ of a free module (projectivity); the excluded residues are the roots of the characteristic polynomial of ψ, and for other s, sΦ₀ − Φ₁ = (s − ψ)Φ₀ with s − ψ invertible.

steps.claim: Let Z = Σ_{s ∈ O} Y ∩ ker(s·Φ₀ − Φ₁).
steps.lean: let Z := ⨆ s : O, Y ⊓ (s • Φ₀ - Φ₁).ker

steps.claim: Z ⊆ Φ₁⁻¹(Φ₀(Z)): for y with s·Φ₀(y) = Φ₁(y), Φ₁(y) = Φ₀(s·y) with s·y ∈ Z.
steps.lean:
have z : Z ≤ (Z.map Φ₀).comap Φ₁ := iSup_le fun s y h ↦
    ⟨_, Z.smul_mem s (mem_iSup_of_mem s h), by aesop⟩

steps.claim: Lift Φ₀ restricted to Z through the projection (O)^m → (O/I)^m: choose σ with Φ₀∘σ = the projection on the image (projective lifting property).
The corresponding map on the preimage is surjective.
Lift Φ₁∘σ to an endomorphism ψ of O^m (projectivity again); T = the roots of the characteristic polynomial of ψ reduced to the residue field, at most |m| of them.
steps.lean:
(projective_lifting_property _ (Φ₁.restrict z ∘ₗ σ) q).elim fun ψ e ↦ ⟨(ψ.charpoly.aroots
    _).toList, by simp [(card_roots_map_le_natDegree _).trans, (finrank_le _).trans,
    charpoly_natDegree], fun s hs ↦ by

steps.claim: For s with residue not in T: det(s − ψ) is a unit, so s − ψ is invertible.
steps.lean:
simp [map_monic_ne_zero, charpoly_monic, eval_charpoly, ← isUnit_iff_isUnit_det,
    End.isUnit_iff] at hs

steps.claim: Split length(Y ∩ ker(sΦ₀ − Φ₁)) (inside Z) into the part in ker Φ₀ and the image under Φ₀ (relLength_add_length_inf, relLength_ker).
steps.lean:
grw [length_mono (le_inf (le_iSup _ s : _ ≤ Z) inf_le_right), ← ENat.add_le_add_iff_left,
    relLength_add_length_inf, ← relLength_add_length_inf _ Φ₀.ker] <;> simp [relLength_ker,
    length_ne_top]

steps.claim: On ker(sΦ₀ − Φ₁) ∩ Z, Φ₁ = ψΦ₀ gives (s − ψ)Φ₀ = 0, so Φ₀ = 0 (s − ψ invertible): the image part is zero and the rest lies in Y ∩ ker Φ₀ ∩ Φ₁⁻¹(Φ₀(Y)).
steps.lean:
exact add_le_add (length_mono (Subtype.forall'.2 ((q.comp hs.2).forall.2 (⟨σ ·, by simp_all [
    DFunLike.ext_iff, -Subtype.forall]⟩)))) (length_mono (by grw [← (by simp [Z] : Z ≤ Y)]; order))⟩
